intended_use: Reference data for cat- and dog-related plant toxicity lookup after a plant has been identified. Not a diagnostic or emergency-care tool.

status_definitions.toxic: The cited source explicitly lists the matched plant taxon as toxic to the specified animal.
status_definitions.non_toxic: The cited source explicitly lists the matched plant taxon as non-toxic to the specified animal; ingestion can still cause symptoms.
status_definitions.unknown: No class-wide status is established for the specified animal, or the taxon match is uncertain. Do not interpret as safe.

general_note: Toxicity depends on the plant taxon and exposure. Common names can refer to different plants. If ingestion is suspected, contact a veterinarian or animal poison-control service; do not rely on this file for treatment decisions.

curation.selection_basis: Curated set of 100 commonly encountered house, garden, and bouquet plant labels for cat-related reference lookup; selected for familiarity and source coverage, not a statistically ranked or globally definitive top-100 list.
curation.unknown_policy: Entries without a class-specific source match remain unknown. Absence of a source record is not evidence of safety.

clinical_effects_note: All 101 entries have a linked cat clinical-effects review and a separate dog review. Reported signs are possible effects named by the linked veterinary source, not predicted symptoms for a photographed plant. Empty lists mean no plant-specific signs were listed; they do not mean ingestion is symptom-free. Serious effects are recorded only where explicitly stated, with exposure and taxonomic qualifiers. No universal severity grade is inferred. Toxicity status and clinical-effects reporting status are separate fields.

kaggle_dataset_note.use: Discovery lead only; no rows copied. Dataset file details and license could not be independently verified. Plant entries cite primary ASPCA or Pet Poison Helpline sources instead.
